en.heading: When to choose Seedance 2.0
en.body: Use it when you need controllable camera language, coherent motion across shots, and synchronized sound without rebuilding the whole pipeline in post.

en.heading: Integration note
en.body: Treat Seedance as the motion layer in SuperCool: prompts and references flow in; mastered clips feed SuperTrack / SuperForge when you need search, signals, or structured assets.

en: Qwen-Image-2.0: high-fidelity generation and editing for product and media teams.
Suited to polished marketing stills, catalog shots, and creative retouching.
Pricing and quotas on Qwen Cloud—compare against Wan if you need heavier editing UX.

計價與配額見 Qwen Cloud；若偏重互動編輯可與 Wan 圖像線一併評估。

en: Google's most capable model with built-in thinking capabilities.
Native multimodal: text, image, audio, video, and file inputs.
1M token context window with leading reasoning and coding benchmarks.
